grace.label: Grace
grace.what: Grace: {{value}} min. Late arrivals within {{value}} min aren't counted.

early.label: Early-leave tolerance
early.what: Leaving up to {{value}} min early isn't counted.

makeup.label: Make-up time
makeup.what: Staying late the same day makes up for coming in late.

present.label: Full day from
present.what: A day counts as present at {{value}}% of the shift.

half.label: Half day from
half.what: A day counts as a half day at {{value}}% of the shift; less is absent.

breakAfter.label: Unpaid break after
breakAfter.what: After {{value}} min of work, the shift's unpaid break is taken off.

breakPunches.label: Break check-out and check-in
breakPunches.what: Staff mark their break in the app instead of the fixed break.

pinEvery.label: PIN on every check-in
pinEvery.what: Staff type their PIN each time, not only on a new day.

selfieIn.label: Selfie on check-in
selfieIn.what: A photo with each check-in, kept for 30 days.

selfieOut.label: Selfie on check-out
selfieOut.what: A photo with each check-out too.

strong.label: Strong mode for everyone
strong.what: Staff must scan the door code to check in. Needs your PIN.

earliest.label: Check-in opens
earliest.what: Check-in opens {{value}} min before the shift starts.

closing.label: Closing time
closing.what: Open check-ins are closed at {{value}} if nobody checks out.

fixWindow.label: Time to ask for a fix
fixWindow.what: Staff can ask to fix a day up to {{value}} days back.

flagAt.label: Look at a check-in from
flagAt.what: A check-in with risk {{value}} or more comes to Needs action. Needs your PIN.

proofAt.label: Ask for proof from
proofAt.what: From risk {{value}} staff must scan the door code or wait for you. Needs your PIN.

divisor.label: Days in a month for pay
divisor.what: Salary per day is worked out on {{value}}.

otThreshold.label: Overtime starts after
otThreshold.what: Work more than {{value}} min past the shift before it counts as overtime.

otBlock.label: Overtime counted in
otBlock.what: Overtime is counted in blocks of {{value}} min.

weekly.label: Weekly hours warning
weekly.what: You're warned when someone is rostered over {{value}} h in a week.

quarterly.label: Overtime warning per quarter
quarterly.what: You're warned when overtime passes {{value}} h in a quarter.

offday.label: Working on a week off or holiday

offdayRate.label: Extra pay for an off day
offdayRate.what: An off day worked is paid at {{value}}.

sandwich.label: Sandwich rule
sandwich.what: A week off between two leave days counts as leave.

payDay.label: Pay by
payDay.what: If salaries aren't marked paid by day {{value}} of the month, you get a reminder.

minWage.label: Minimum wage check
minWage.what: Payslips below the minimum wage get a warning.

dailyHolidays.label: Daily-paid staff: paid holidays
dailyHolidays.what: Staff paid by the day are paid for holidays.

dailyWeekOffs.label: Daily-paid staff: paid week offs
dailyWeekOffs.what: Staff paid by the day are paid for week offs.

cl.label: Casual leave a year
cl.what: {{value}} days of casual leave a year.

sl.label: Sick leave a year
sl.what: {{value}} days of sick leave a year.

usableAfter.label: Leave usable after
usableAfter.what: New staff can take paid leave after {{value}} days.

clNotice.label: Notice for casual leave
clNotice.what: Casual leave is asked {{value}} days ahead.

slBackdate.label: Sick leave asked later
slBackdate.what: Sick leave can be asked up to {{value}} days after.

compOff.label: Comp-off lasts
compOff.what: A day off earned for working an off day lasts {{value}} days.

earned.label: Earned leave
earned.what: Staff earn leave for days worked.

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.what: No alerts at night, except a new phone waiting for you.

summaryOnly.label: Summaries only
summaryOnly.what: One morning and one evening summary instead of each alert.

morning.label: Morning summary
morning.what: The morning summary comes {{value}} min after the first shift starts.

lang.label: Staff app language
lang.what: New staff see the app in {{value}}.

payslips.label: Show payslips to staff
payslips.what: Staff see their payslip in the app once you finalise.

grievanceName.label: Contact for privacy questions
grievanceName.what: Staff are told to ask this person.

creditsOn.label: Time credits
creditsOn.what: Late, early and away minutes and approved overtime go to a ledger only you see. Nothing is cut or paid until you settle it at payroll. Needs your PIN.

creditsStart.label: Start counting from
creditsStart.what: Days from {{value}} count. Earlier days keep the usual late and overtime rules.

legalOt2x.label: Pay legal overtime at 2×
legalOt2x.what: Overtime beyond 9 h a day or 48 h a week counts twice in the ledger, as the law requires. Off, payroll shows a shortfall warning. Needs your PIN.
